scientific_integrity: All equations are proved within the stated setting; numerics corroborate but do not replace proof. The established Hermite-Laguerre ambiguity identity and generic minimax crossing tools are credited. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Gaussian and first-Hermite windows, fixed disk, homogeneous exposure allocation and a prewhitened L2 ambiguity multiplier.
Only the linear inversion step is optimized; finite-sample and nonlinear phase retrieval are not covered.
The stated sharp stability coefficient does not model correlated or nonwhite measurement errors without an additional whitening hypothesis.
Priority relative to any unpublished or unidentified equivalent minimax spectral-design statement remains open.
title: A sharp exposure-allocation transition for Gaussian and first-Hermite ambiguity inversion
